description: This script provides functions to identify the filesystem type of a given image by reading magic words and specific patterns, including detecting 'ubifs', 'squashfs', 'jffs2', or 'unknown'. It also includes utility functions for reading binary data and calculating aligned sizes.

methods.name: get_magic_word
methods.description: Reads the first 4 bytes of a file and returns their hexadecimal representation.

methods.name: get_post_padding_word
methods.description: Checks the end of a root filesystem image for a specific marker value, used to distinguish filesystem types.

methods.name: get_fs_type
methods.description: Determines the filesystem type (ubifs, squashfs, squashfs-jffs2, or unknown) of a given image file.

methods.name: round_up
methods.description: Calculates the smallest multiple of a given number greater than or equal to the input value.
